g.text: • Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS JWT Bearer
• PBKDF2 Salted Basic Auth & Kerberos SPNEGO
🚀 Seamless SSO · No Shared DB Credentials
• Automated Export to AWS S3 WORM Object Lock
• Unified RBAC: GatewayRole Hierarchy (Admin, Owner, Consumer)
⚙️ Canonical Enterprise Identity Across All Channels
• Fail-Closed Default: Denies Any Non-Consented Entity (FORBIDDEN)
• Casbin ABAC Engine (sub_rule) + OpenFGA ReBAC Graph Resolution
🛡️ Ensures Zero Unauthorized Data Ever Leaves Gateway
• AstSecurityVisitor: Injects RLS Filters Directly into SQL WHERE Tree
• AstSimplifier: Constant Folding, De Morgan, Tautology Reduction (1=1)
• Code Emitters: PostgreSQL ($1), T-SQL ([...]), SQLite, Oracle (:p1)
⚡ Native DB Pushdown · Total Immunity to SQL Injections
• Compiled SQL Query Plan Cache: Sub-Millisecond Repeat Executions
• Format-Preserving Masking: Clear, Mask (Span<char>), Redact, HMAC
• Data Health Circuit Breaker: Quarantines Dirty Data
🛡️ Halts Bad Data Before Reaching End Users
• Auto GDPR Art. 9 Tagging & PII Masking Maps
🚀 Dynamic PII Masking Inherited from Catalogs
• Redis Pub/Sub: Monotonic Cache Epoch Invalidation
• OpenJEV AI Justification Triage & Backstage Catalog
